actions.description: Capture a single image from a named camera with a declared resolution and exposure and return an image artifact reference.
actions.name: capture_image

facts.text: The node main creates an rclcpp node named astra_camera.
The color branch creates a publisher on the relative topic 'image' with message type sensor_msgs::msg::Image and sensor-data QoS.
The driver requests the color video mode with PIXEL_FORMAT_RGB888.
The frame listener maps PIXEL_FORMAT_RGB888 to the ROS RGB8 encoding and sets step to 3 bytes per pixel.
The frame listener fills width and height from the device frame, copies the frame data, and sets is_bigendian to 0.
The color callback assigns the configured color frame id to the image header and publishes the image on the color publisher.
The color publisher is created only inside the hasColorSensor branch.
The node main initializes the color request to width 1280, height 1024 and frame rate 30.
parse_command_options replaces the color width, height and frame rate from the -w, -h and -f command-line options.
rawToFloatingPointConversion sets the new image encoding to TYPE_32FC1 and step to sizeof(float)*width, maps unsigned-short samples equal to 0 or 0x7FF to NaN and divides every other sample by 1000.
The depth branch creates a publisher on the relative 'depth' topic with message type sensor_msgs::msg::Image.
The depth branch publishes the converted floating-point image through pub_depth_raw_.
The depth branch publishes a CameraInfo message on the relative 'depth_camera_info' topic.
The -C command-line option sets use_color to false.
The node sets the use_color parameter from the parsed command-line option when it is not already set.
